researchIterations.summary: Main thread verified official inventory and GPX/API baseline. HÖ23 GPX has 708 trackpoints, one segment, 15.926311 km, start 57.465293/13.890343, end 57.41912/13.73377, one gap over 100 m, none over 150 m, one duplicate consecutive point, HÖ22-HÖ23 gap 1.280 m and direct GPX available while .kml/.geojson/.json variants returned 404/406 HTML.

No second targeted batch was needed because remaining issues are normalization/currentness caveats: weak endpoint access, no public potable water, pending OSM shelter, private/off-route facility classification, no post-Storm-Dave clearance, spelling aliases and connector topology.

importReadiness.summary: HÖ23 has navigation-grade official GPX/API geometry and now also a research-only official-GPX-derived GeoJSON artifact for later import planning. The previous practical caveats have been resolved into explicit import rules: suppress unverified OSM/TillSkogs lean-to until field/official verification, suppress Sörgården as public trail facility/parking, keep Åsafors and Kärringabacka as non-parking access/junction metadata, treat no public potable water as a negative finding, and keep fire/storm status as live checks.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: HÖ23 leaves the shared Åsafors endpoint and follows the Höglandsleden west branch through a quiet, service-sparse forest stage to Kärringabacka, where the route meets Järnbärarleden connections toward Hestra/Isaberg and Töllstorp/Gnosjö. Use the official GPX as route geometry, keep Åsafors and Kärringabacka as pickup/dropoff or junction metadata rather than parking trailheads, carry enough water, and treat onward transit as mainly available through the Järnbärarleden continuations. Verify fire status and post-Storm-Dave trail clearance before publication.
